# Shaan Puri Voice Corpus

Research date: 2026-09-09

The excerpts below are short quotations from public newsletter posts and a public podcast transcript, included under fair use for style analysis and attribution. They are third-party content and NOT covered by this repository's MIT license.

**Provenance note.** Items 1-27 were read directly from shaanpuri.com "One Minute Blog" posts on the research date and are verbatim. Items 28-32 come from an auto-generated (ASR) YouTube caption track for a My First Million episode and are labeled `documented`; wording may be imperfect, verify before quoting as exact.

## Documented, from an ASR YouTube transcript

Auto-generated captions (`generated=True`), My First Million channel, video "7 things Bezos, MrBeast & Thiel do that you don't", videoId jZT04e4yBb0. Wording may contain transcription errors; re-verify against the audio before quoting as exact.

28. "If this was a VHS tape, it would be labeled Shan Hardcore Part Two." `documented`

29. "I love it like dudes love Pokemon cards." `documented`, describing his love of "frame breaking" stories.

30. "The stories I'm going to tell you are sort of like elephant in the stake things where you're like, 'Oh, I could I couldn't possibly do that.'" `documented`, the elephant-and-stake analogy for self-imposed limits.

31. "Option drop." `documented`, a recurring bit he repeats as a punchline while describing a founder's spontaneous equity-grant habit.

32. "The more specific, the more concrete, and the more immediate a reward, the more of that behavior you're going to get." `documented`, his summary of the option-drop story as basic behavioral science.

## Structural notes for the writer

- Every post names a real person, a real dollar figure, or a real percentage. Vague advice with no specific attached is off-voice.
- The framework name always arrives after the story, never before it. Do not open with the jargon term.
- Sign-off is "-Uncle Shaan" or "-Shaan" on its own line; this is a consistent structural tell across the newsletter corpus.
- On the podcast his sentences run much longer and looser than the newsletter, with self-interruptions and repeated punchlines ("Option drop." said twice for the laugh).
- He credits outside sources by name inside the story itself (Ben Kuhn, Kevin Kelly, Picasso, Naval, Alex Hormozi), never as a citation or footnote.
